basicMemory.placementConventions: CAPSLOCK.md files at root (SKOGAI.md, CLAUDE.md, CORE.md, DECISIONS.md, NOTATION.md, WORKSTATION.md) are hand-maintained router/index files, not generated content. knowledge/memory/ holds atomic fact notes indexed by knowledge/memory/MEMORY.md. .inbox/ is the quick-capture dumping ground; tmp/ is repo-local scratch space. Coding-session checkpoints go in sessions/; schemas/ holds Picoschema definitions. DECISIONS.md is a hand-curated running log -- the Decision schema is additive for new granular decisions, not a replacement for it.
